description: Main roster table of the Shōwa 現役将校実役停年名簿. Officers run right-to-left as vertical column strips; the eleven horizontal bands are the field rows. Sections are headed by branch+rank (e.g. 歩兵大佐) printed in the outer margin, so a page may contain the tail of one section and the head of the next.

provenance.method: Ruling positions detected per panel (reading/registration.py), pooled as fractions of table height, clustered at 0.015 and kept where support >= 60% of panels; band = cluster median. Frame 850 (索引) and frame 700 panel 1 were excluded as non-main layouts and serve as negative controls.

match.note: Three gates. min_bands_matched: main-layout panels detect 11-12 of the 12 bands, index pages far fewer (Spike C); two misses are tolerated because thin rulings drop out on degraded panels. min_explained_frac: the reverse direction — measured 92-100% on true main panels versus 46-71% on index and degraded panels, so 0.8 sits in a wide gap and rejects over-detected pages that would otherwise match 12/12 by chance. min_columns: without interior vertical rulings no officer strip can be cut, so the page is a human task, not a registration.

columns.note: Nominal count only, never a gate: a page ending one branch+rank section and starting another carries fewer full columns. Officer index 0 is the rightmost strip.

fields.name: date_row_1
fields.note: UNCONFIRMED. Almost entirely 同 (ditto) across the section; the rightmost cell of the sampled page reads 〇、一、一. Not obviously a date. Needs the lead's reading against a printed section header before it is given a real name.

fields.name: date_row_2
fields.note: UNCONFIRMED. Also almost entirely 同; rightmost cell reads 昭八、一 (Shōwa 8, 1) — a value shared across the section rather than per-officer.

fields.name: rank_date
fields.note: PROVISIONAL. Recent dates (昭和3-8, 大正15) varying per officer — consistent with appointment to the officer's current rank, i.e. the seniority basis for this section. No observation column exists for it yet.

fields.name: commissioning_date
fields.note: PROVISIONAL but well supported. Early dates (明治41-44, 大正1-3) — roughly 25 years before the volume, consistent with first commissioning (任官年月日), which is the schema's single date column.

fields.name: seniority_no
fields.note: Arabic numerals, monotone ascending right-to-left within each branch+rank section (globally numbered, so sections start with gaps). The row anchor for audit — see roster_cell.seniority_no.

fields.name: post
fields.note: 職名 — the assignment (e.g. 歩兵第四十二聯隊附, 陸軍兵器本廠附), with the posting date in smaller type at the foot of the cell. Tallest band.

fields.name: court_rank_decorations
fields.note: 位階・勲等・功級 — e.g. 正六、旭六、瑞五 (Senior Sixth Rank; Rising Sun 6th; Sacred Treasure 5th). No observation column yet.

fields.name: name_raw
fields.note: 氏名 in large type with the birth date in smaller type alongside (e.g. 伊東武夫 / 明三〇、七、六). Transcription must separate the two; the band holds both.

fields.name: cohort
fields.note: 陸軍士官学校 class number (期), e.g. 23. A Spike-D blocking key for linkage to the academy dataset.

unassigned_bands.note: Top margin above the table rule — no field.
Bottom margin — no field. Page number sits outside the table in the outer margin.
